subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should the shipped `openclaw agent --message-file` contract reject files above 4 MiB?
rationale: Bounding the whole-file read fixes a real availability risk, but selecting the permanent maximum changes accepted user input and is not determined by an existing shared agent-input contract.

options.title: Accept 4 MiB
options.body: Merge this focused hardening with 4 MiB as the supported agent message-file maximum.

options.title: Select another maximum
options.body: Retain the implementation shape but adjust the constant and tests to an owner-approved canonical prompt-input limit.

recommendation.title: Accept 4 MiB
recommendation.body: Merge this focused hardening with 4 MiB as the supported agent message-file maximum.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original feature and are the strongest available owner for accepting an upgrade-visible change to its public CLI behavior.
